clue.text: Say the wrong thing when you step in something unpleasant

definitions.meaning: to make a tactless remark that causes embarrassment
taken literally, planting a shoe in a mess on the pavement

explanation.walkthrough: The idiom for a social blunder is read literally as treading in something nasty.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means committing a gaffe, and literally describes treading in muck.

clue.text: Fat parrot said to be dry

indicators.note: said signals that the parrot's pet name is to be heard rather than spelt

parts.note: Polly is the traditional name for a pet parrot
dry means not soaked, that is not saturated

explanation.surface: A remark that a plump parrot is parched.
explanation.walkthrough: 'said' makes POLLY sound like POLY; UNSATURATED for dry is a stretch, since dry things are not saturated with water.
explanation.definitionFit: A polyunsaturated fat is a kind of dietary oil whose molecules have several double bonds.

clue.text: Beat broth into a pulp

indicators.note: beating something into a pulp mashes it, so the letters of broth are mashed into a new order

explanation.surface: A cooking instruction to mash soup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beat' looks like a cooking verb but is the definition, a noun or verb for a pulse.
explanation.definitionFit: A throb is a strong regular pulse, as of the heart.

clue.text: Work or speak about physical education

indicators.note: about here means going around, so the word for speaking surrounds the school subject

parts.note: to orate is to speak formally

explanation.surface: Choosing between a job or a lecture on gym class.
explanation.definitionFit: To operate a machine is to work it.

clue.text: First-class model initially in torn clothing

indicators.note: in places the first-class pieces inside the word for torn

parts.note: rent is an old word for torn
A1 means first-class, written AI

indicators.note: initially takes just the opening letter of model

explanation.surface: A top model wearing ripped clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Raiment is an old literary word for garments.

clue.text: Shock where in France there is great commotion

annotationWithheld.why: Shock where in France there is great commotion: OU (where in France) and RAGE (commotion) leave a T with no clue word to supply it
annotationWithheld.clue: Shock where in France there is great commotion

clue.text: A unit is exchanged in the country…

indicators.note: exchanged means the letters swap places to form a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A military unit is swapped around in some country.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue runs on into 7-down; here 'the country' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Tunisia is a North African nation on the Mediterranean.

clue.text: for account given by a bishop in the country

indicators.note: in puts the article and bishop inside the word for country

parts.note: a nation is a country
RR, Right Reverend, is the title of a bishop

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue: a bishop's account of the country.
explanation.walkthrough: Right Reverend is the formal style of a bishop, so the clue's bishop gives its abbreviation; 'in' tucks the article and that title inside the country.
explanation.definitionFit: A narration is a spoken or written account of events.

clue.text: But it is not where youngsters are sent to learn to be engine drivers

definitions.text: But it is not where youngsters are sent to learn to be engine drivers

parts.words: But it is not where youngsters are sent to learn to be engine drivers
parts.note: the name suggests a school for railway work, yet such places prepare teachers

explanation.definitionFit: A training college was an institution where teachers were educated.

clue.text: One taking things is strangely silent going round the bend

indicators.note: going round means the scrambled letters encircle the curve
strangely means the letters of silent are rearranged

parts.note: an arc is a curve or bend

explanation.surface: A quiet thief cornering on the road.
explanation.definitionFit: A larcenist commits theft, the crime of taking another's property.

clue.text: Mean with a girl

parts.note: the norm is the average, the mean

explanation.surface: Unkind behaviour towards a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Norma is a female forename.

clue.text: You would be offended if you take it

definitions.text: You would be offended if you take it

parts.words: You would be offended if you take it
parts.note: the idiom of taking something meaning to feel slighted

explanation.definitionFit: To take umbrage is the set phrase for becoming offended.

clue.text: Don't vote and put Jack on the spot

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, AB being able seaman
a spot is a mark or stain

explanation.surface: Instructions to refuse a ballot and put someone on the spot.
explanation.definitionFit: To abstain is to decline to cast a ballot.

clue.text: Keep on at the poor creature

explanation.definitionFit: To pester is to keep on at someone, and an old worn horse is also called this.

clue.text: Subordinate topic

definitions.meaning: a person under the authority of a ruler

explanation.definitionFit: A citizen under a monarch is one; so is the theme of a talk.

clue.text: Striker has prize flower

parts.note: a butter is one who butts, striking with the head
a cup is a trophy

explanation.surface: A footballer wins a trophy and a bouquet.
explanation.definitionFit: The buttercup is a yellow wild plant of meadows.

clue.text: One who lacks the instincts of a gentleman is about these days

definitions.text: One who lacks the instincts of a gentleman

parts.note: C, circa, means about
AD, anno Domini, marks the present era

explanation.surface: Gentlemanly manners are rare nowadays.
explanation.definitionFit: A cad is a man who behaves dishonourably, a bounder.

clue.text: Excuse noise going round upsetting Virginia

indicators.note: going round means the jumbled letters wrap around the state
upsetting means the letters of noise are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A disturbance upsets Virginia and someone makes an excuse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upsetting' sits by Virginia as though it acted on the state, but it scrambles the noise, which then goes round the state's abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: An evasion is a dodge or pretext used to avoid something.

clue.text: By way of the old road

definitions.meaning: in Latin the word means road

explanation.definitionFit: The preposition means passing through; in Latin, the language of old Rome, it was a road.

clue.text: Valve used to deter vandalism

indicators.note: vandalism wrecks things, so the letters of to deter are smashed into a new order

explanation.surface: A valve fitted to discourage vandals.
explanation.definitionFit: A tetrode is a thermionic valve with four electrodes.

clue.text: Grow too big for one's hat and coat perhaps

explanation.definitionFit: Outgrowing garments is one sense; garments for going outdoors, like a hat and coat, are the other.

clue.text: A murder involved part of the body

indicators.note: involved means twisted up, so the letters of a murder are rearranged

explanation.surface: A body part implicated in a killing.
explanation.definitionFit: The eardrum is the membrane in the middle ear.

clue.text: Using few words for non-clerical study inside

indicators.note: inside places the word for study within the word for non-clerical

parts.note: laic means of the laity, not clergy
to con is to study

explanation.surface: Terse language used in lay study.
explanation.definitionFit: Laconic speech is terse, using a minimum of words.

clue.text: Disinclined to give Scotsman a region north of the border

definitions.text: a region north of the border

parts.note: loth means reluctant
Ian is a typical Scottish man's name

explanation.surface: Reluctant to hand over a Scottish area to a Scot.
explanation.definitionFit: Lothian is an area of Scotland around Edinburgh; 'north of the border' means in Scotland.

clue.text: Grades for many girls

parts.note: C, the Roman hundred, stands for many
lasses are girls

explanation.surface: Many girls being graded.
explanation.definitionFit: Classes are ranks or grades in a system.

clue.text: Difficulty not regarding worship

indicators.note: not means the word for regarding is left out

parts.note: to adore is to worship
re means regarding

explanation.surface: Trouble from someone without religious devotion.
explanation.definitionFit: Ado means fuss or trouble, as in without further ado.

clue.text: Go back in for some more bizarre entertainment

indicators.note: some means only part of the following words is used

explanation.surface: Returning to a show for a bit more weird fun.
explanation.definitionFit: To re-enter is to come back into a place.

clue.text: Right back to be of use when there is hard work

indicators.note: back means the abbreviation for right is turned around

parts.note: to avail is to be of use

explanation.surface: Right back proving useful in a hard match.
explanation.definitionFit: Travail is painful toil or labour.

clue.text: Siege in Texas, Alabama and Missouri

parts.note: Ala is the traditional abbreviation for Alabama

explanation.surface: Listing US states including Texas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Texas' seems to be a third state, but belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The Alamo, San Antonio, was besieged by Mexican forces in 1836.

clue.text: Cheat removing clasp

indicators.note: read as re-moving, the letters of cheat are moved again into a new order

explanation.surface: A fraudster taking off a fastening.
explanation.definitionFit: A tache is an archaic word for a buckle or fastening.

clue.text: Re-establish power at gallery!

parts.note: the reins of power means control
the Tate is a London art gallery

explanation.surface: Restoring authority at an art museum.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinstate is to restore someone to a former position.

clue.text: Where one can find a whole range of counter-attractions

definitions.text: Where one can find a whole range of counter-attractions

parts.words: Where one can find a whole range of counter-attractions
parts.note: counter-attractions read as goods displayed on shop counters

explanation.definitionFit: A large shop selling many kinds of goods in separate sections.
